def _calibrate_diagnostics(probe, events, manifest, remaining_seconds):
    import hashlib
    import time

    actual = probe.network
    device = actual.item_emb.weight.device
    started = time.perf_counter()
    allowance = min(20.0, max(0.0, remaining_seconds))
    deadline = started + allowance
    atol, rtol = 1e-6, 1e-5

    class Deadline(Exception):
        pass

    def boundary():
        if device.type == "cuda":
            torch.cuda.synchronize(device)
        if time.perf_counter() >= deadline:
            raise Deadline("Calibration deadline reached; running operations cannot be interrupted")

    def close(a, b):
        if a.shape != b.shape or not torch.isfinite(a).all() or not torch.isfinite(b).all():
            raise ValueError("Invalid calibration comparison")
        return bool(((a - b).abs() <= atol + rtol * b.abs()).all().item())

    cases = []
    vocab = int(actual.itemnum)
    source = probe.user_train.get("History", probe.user_train)
    observed = {str(u): set(map(int, h)) for u, h in source.items()}
    for event in events[:16]:
        occupied = np.flatnonzero(event["sequence"])
        interior = occupied[:-1]
        cuts = sorted(set(
            int(interior[i]) for i in (0, len(interior) // 2, len(interior) - 1)
        )) if len(interior) else []
        excluded = observed.get(event["user"], set()) | set(event["candidates"])
        replacement = next((i for i in range(1, vocab + 1) if i not in excluded), None)
        for t in cuts:
            j = int(occupied[occupied > t][0])
            edited = list(event["sequence"])
            if replacement is not None:
                edited[j] = replacement
            cases.append({
                "user": event["user"], "t": t, "j": j,
                "sequence": event["sequence"], "edited": edited,
                "candidates": event["candidates"],
                "replacement_available": replacement is not None,
            })
        if not cuts:
            cases.append({
                "user": event["user"], "t": None, "j": None,
                "sequence": event["sequence"], "edited": event["sequence"],
                "candidates": event["candidates"], "replacement_available": False,
            })

    variants = {
        "unchanged": ("readout", "prefix", "sensitivity"),
        "identity_hook": ("readout", "prefix", "sensitivity"),
        "wrong_readout": ("readout",),
        "future_feature_mix": ("prefix",),
        "constant_features": ("sensitivity",),
    }
    cells = []
    for variant, targets in variants.items():
        for target in targets:
            seen = set()
            for case in cases:
                if target != "prefix" and case["user"] in seen:
                    continue
                seen.add(case["user"])
                cells.append({
                    "variant": variant, "probe": target, "case": case,
                    "scheduled": 1, "executed": 0, "active": 0,
                    "independently_violated": 0, "independently_passed": 0,
                    "unresolved": 0, "invalid": 0, "alarmed": 0,
                    "not_run": 1, "reason": "Not reached",
                })
    protocol = {
        "seed": 42, "cases": cases, "atol": atol, "rtol": rtol,
        "reference_side": "b in abs(a-b) <= atol + rtol*abs(b)",
        "seconds": allowance, "total_category_seconds": 120.0,
        "dtype": "FP32", "autocast": False, "tf32": False,
        "variants_and_target_probes": variants,
        "affected_module": "blocks.0 observation/identity hook; ModelView feature callable",
        "mutations": {
            "wrong_readout": "Diagnostic readout only: occupied count minus one",
            "future_feature_mix": "Diagnostic features only: h[t] += h[j], coefficient 1",
            "constant_features": "Diagnostic features only: zeros at every position",
            "identity_hook": "First residual block output cloned without modification",
        },
        "rules": {
            "readout": "Alarm when chosen-readout scores disagree with frozen deployed score_candidates",
            "prefix": "Alarm when any feature at positions <=t changes under a later-token edit",
            "sensitivity": "Alarm when distinct histories have equal candidate scores",
        },
        "independence": {
            "readout": "Independent NumPy structural index oracle versus score-agreement detector",
            "prefix": "Integration self-check: oracle and detector test the same numerical property",
            "sensitivity": "Behavioral challenge without a universal correctness label",
        },
        "checkpoint_identity": None,
        "localization_accuracy": None,
        "localization_missing_reason": "No independently specified reference circuit",
    }
    result = {"protocol": protocol, "cells": cells, "status": "initializing"}
    manifest["mutation_calibration"] = result

    class VariantView:
        def __init__(self, base, variant, case, counters):
            self.base, self.variant, self.case = base, variant, case
            self.counters = counters
            self.original = base.log2feats
            self.model = base.model

        def __getattr__(self, name):
            return getattr(self.base, name)

        def log2feats(self, sequence):
            self.counters["feature_callable"] += 1
            h = self.original(sequence)
            if self.variant == "constant_features":
                return torch.zeros_like(h, dtype=torch.float32)
            if self.variant == "future_feature_mix":
                h = h.clone()
                h[:, self.case["t"]] += h[:, self.case["j"]].clone()
            return h

        def diagnostic_readout(self, sequence):
            self.counters["readout_callable"] += 1
            if self.variant == "wrong_readout":
                return sequence.ne(0).sum(1) - 1
            positions = torch.arange(sequence.shape[1], device=sequence.device)
            return positions.expand_as(sequence).masked_fill(sequence.eq(0), -1).max(1).values

    try:
        boundary()
        digest = hashlib.sha256()
        for name, value in actual.state_dict().items():
            boundary()
            digest.update(name.encode())
            digest.update(value.detach().cpu().contiguous().numpy().tobytes())
        protocol["checkpoint_identity"] = {"sha256_state_dict": digest.hexdigest()}
        boundary()
        result["pre_execution_manifest"] = probe._write_manifest(manifest)
        if not result["pre_execution_manifest"]["written"]:
            raise ValueError("Replay manifest could not be saved before outcomes")
        result["status"] = "running"
        for cell in cells:
            boundary()
            case, variant, target = cell["case"], cell["variant"], cell["probe"]
            if target in ("prefix", "sensitivity") and not case["replacement_available"]:
                cell["reason"] = "No eligible later-token replacement or interior cut"
                continue
            cell["not_run"], cell["executed"] = 0, 1
            counters = {"feature_callable": 0, "readout_callable": 0, "module_hook": 0}
            cell["execution"] = counters
            handle = None
            try:
                sequence = torch.tensor([case["sequence"]], device=device, dtype=torch.long)
                edited = torch.tensor([case["edited"]], device=device, dtype=torch.long)
                ids = torch.tensor(case["candidates"], device=device, dtype=torch.long)
                # Immutable unmodified references are evaluated before injection.
                boundary()
                baseline = probe._features(sequence)
                boundary()
                baseline_other = probe._features(edited) if target != "readout" else baseline
                baseline_prefix_ok = close(
                    baseline_other[:, :case["t"] + 1], baseline[:, :case["t"] + 1]
                ) if target == "prefix" else True
                if variant == "future_feature_mix" and not baseline_prefix_ok:
                    cell["invalid"] = 1
                    cell["reason"] = "Unmodified prefix invariance failed; injection attribution invalid"
                    continue

                def hook(module, args, output):
                    counters["module_hook"] += 1
                    return output.clone() if variant == "identity_hook" else None

                handle = actual.blocks[0].register_forward_hook(hook)
                view = VariantView(probe.view, variant, case, counters)
                modified = type(probe)(view, probe.device)
                if modified.network is not actual:
                    raise ValueError("Diagnostic variant changed network ownership")
                boundary()
                a = modified._features(sequence)
                boundary()
                b = modified._features(edited) if target != "readout" else a
                selected = modified._diagnostic_readout(sequence)
                reference_index = int(np.flatnonzero(np.asarray(case["sequence"]) != 0)[-1])
                cell["active"] = int(
                    int(selected[0]) != reference_index if variant == "wrong_readout"
                    else True
                )
                if target == "readout":
                    violated = int(selected[0]) != reference_index
                    cell["selected_index"] = int(selected[0])
                    cell["reference_index"] = reference_index
                    cell["independently_violated"] = int(violated)
                    cell["independently_passed"] = int(not violated)
                    cell["behavior_changed"] = not close(a[:, int(selected[0])], baseline[:, reference_index])
                elif target == "prefix":
                    prefix_equal = close(b[:, :case["t"] + 1], a[:, :case["t"] + 1])
                    cell["oracle_prefix_equal"] = prefix_equal
                    cell["source_feature_changed"] = not close(
                        baseline_other[:, case["j"]], baseline[:, case["j"]]
                    )
                    cell["behavior_changed"] = not prefix_equal
                    cell["unresolved"] = int(variant == "future_feature_mix" and prefix_equal)
                    cell["validation_kind"] = "integration_self_check"
                    # Equivalent oracle/probe assertions are excluded from independent rates.
                else:
                    cell["unresolved"] = 1
                    cell["reason"] = "History sensitivity has no universal correctness label"
                    cell["baseline_features_equal"] = close(baseline_other, baseline)
                    cell["variant_features_equal"] = close(b, a)
                boundary()
                alarm = modified.run_frozen_target_probes(case, target, boundary)
                cell["alarmed"] = int(alarm)
                if not counters["feature_callable"] or not counters["module_hook"]:
                    raise ValueError("Injected callable/module path did not execute")
                cell.setdefault("validation_kind", "independent_structural_oracle" if target == "readout" else "behavioral_challenge")
                if cell["reason"] == "Not reached":
                    cell["reason"] = None
            except Deadline:
                cell["unresolved"] = 1
                cell["reason"] = "Interrupted between bounded calibration operations"
                raise
            except (ValueError, TypeError, AttributeError, RuntimeError) as exc:
                cell["invalid"] = 1
                cell["independently_violated"] = cell["independently_passed"] = 0
                cell["reason"] = f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"
            finally:
                if handle is not None:
                    handle.remove()
        result["status"] = "completed"
    except Deadline as exc:
        result["status"], result["reason"] = "budget_limited", str(exc)
    except (ValueError, TypeError, AttributeError, RuntimeError) as exc:
        result["status"], result["reason"] = "invalid", f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"
    finally:
        if device.type == "cuda":
            torch.cuda.synchronize(device)
        result["elapsed_seconds"] = time.perf_counter() - started
        result["overrun_seconds"] = max(0.0, result["elapsed_seconds"] - allowance)
        for cell in cells:
            if cell["not_run"] and cell["reason"] == "Not reached":
                cell["reason"] = result.get("reason", "Calibration scheduling stopped")
    result["fault_probe_counts"] = {}
    fields = ("scheduled", "executed", "active", "independently_violated", "independently_passed", "unresolved", "invalid", "alarmed", "not_run")
    for variant, targets in variants.items():
        for target in targets:
            rows = [r for r in cells if r["variant"] == variant and r["probe"] == target]
            summary = {key: sum(r[key] for r in rows) for key in fields}
            labeled = [r for r in rows if not r["invalid"] and r["independently_violated"]]
            passed = [r for r in rows if not r["invalid"] and r["independently_passed"]]
            summary["detection_rate"] = {
                "numerator": sum(r["alarmed"] for r in labeled), "denominator": len(labeled),
                "value": sum(r["alarmed"] for r in labeled) / len(labeled) if labeled else None,
            }
            summary["oracle_passed_alarm_rate"] = {
                "numerator": sum(r["alarmed"] for r in passed), "denominator": len(passed),
                "value": sum(r["alarmed"] for r in passed) / len(passed) if passed else None,
            }
            result["fault_probe_counts"][f"{variant}/{target}"] = summary
    return result
